name: aurora-motion
vibe: An ambient aurora film — flowing ribbons and curtains of accent light drifting across a dark sky, soft mesh-gradient blooms breathing on lissajous paths and luminous motes rising, all painted on one canvas that flows unbroken across every cut. Over the light float minimal, elegant kinetic typography: glass badges, big gradient statements, frosted-glass screen frames that hold real screenshots, glass feature cards and a luminous logo-reveal CTA. Everything is theme-driven, so the brand color repaints the whole sky — the aurora ribbons, the mesh blooms, the background wash, the glows and the CTA, not just the text. Calm, premium, cinematic, dreamy. Portrait-native 9:16 for Reels, Shorts and TikTok. Rendered as a native GSAP + canvas composition. Best for premium brand films, app/SaaS launches, ambient product reveals, screenshots and anything that should feel soft, luminous and high-end.
